_about: Which facts a port carries in the Lexicon, their type, which sources are authoritative (most authoritative first), and how long a checked value stays fresh. Format: Project-Sophos sophos/src/lexicon/packs.mjs. A position is a geo value with a tolerance (operator ruling 2026-10-29): two sources within it name the same place. place_position is the destination a guide is about (a town, an island); terminal_position is where a ship docks or tenders, which can lie kilometres away and is a different place, not a disputed one. 5 km for a destination is the threshold the Lexicon plan's census used (37 of 330 page-versus-registry pairs beyond it); 500 m for a terminal or pier. name is the short name the registry gives ("Abu Dhabi"); page_place_name is the name a page uses for its place, often qualified with a terminal or region ("Abu Dhabi / Zayed Port", "Airlie Beach, Queensland"). They are two facts, not one disputed fact. Tekton itw-c6-port-pack; assets/data/entities/README.md. Soli Deo Gloria.

identity.key: port:<slug>, where <slug> is the In the Wake port page slug (ports/<slug>.html). Every list keyed by slug maps to it directly; a list keyed by name maps only on an exact normalized name, and anything else is listed as unmatched, never guessed (assets/data/lexicon/port-aliases.json).

source_kinds.gazetteer: a public gazetteer read in the session; evidence tier primary. GeoNames (CC BY 4.0), read for the disputed ports by admin/lexicon/port-gazetteer.mjs into assets/data/lexicon/gazetteer/geonames-ports.json (Tekton itw-c6b-port-gazetteer)
source_kinds.port-authority: the port authority's or cruise line's own page for a terminal or tender point; evidence tier primary
source_kinds.itw-data: a data file or page already in this repository; evidence tier secondary
